component.name: zid
component.summary: GPU-accelerated editor with Markdown preview and a local AI assistant

description.p: zid is a text editor written in Zig. It renders through Vulkan, runs on Wayland and X11, and keeps its features in one window instead of an extension market.

ul.li: Editor with tree-sitter syntax highlighting, split panes and a file explorer
Markdown preview, Marp slides and PDF export
PDF viewer, image viewer and an integrated terminal
Git views: diff, timeline, source control graph and commits
AI chat against a local llama-server or Ollama; no data leaves the machine

description.p: Windows: zid logo as program and taskbar icon.
Search and replace across the project (Ctrl+Shift+F / Ctrl+Shift+H), powered by ripgrep.
Release binaries run on every x86-64 CPU again (0.1.1 needed AVX2).
Files with CRLF line endings no longer count as modified after opening; invalid UTF-8 no longer crashes zid.
Color emoji in editor, preview and chat; the font is fetched on first use.
The chat sets up its own engine and model, Ollama is gone.
Undo and double-click in the small text fields, selection across chat messages.
